text: He saw himself lying on the hot sand near a stream after a cold summer soup, while his children dug in the sand nearby. <break time="0.8s" /> He dozed sweetly, thinking of nothing and feeling that he did not need to go to the office today, tomorrow, or the day after. <break time="0.8s" /> In the evening, after a swim in the river and tea with cream, he would take a walk or play cards with the neighbors. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes, it would be nice to buy an estate, said his wife, and it was clear from her face that she was enchanted by her own thoughts. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan pictured autumn walks by the river, and after them the gloomy days when rain fell day and night and there was nowhere to go. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan stopped walking, looked at his wife, and said, You know, Masha, I would go abroad. <break time="0.8s" /> He began to think how nice it would be to travel in late autumn to the south of France, or to Italy, or even to India. <break time="0.8s" /> I would certainly go abroad too, said his wife, but look at the number of the ticket. <break time="0.8s" /> Walking about the room, Ivan suddenly wondered what it would be like if his wife really went abroad with him. <break time="0.8s" /> He pictured her in the train with many bags and baskets, sighing over every coin and complaining that the trip gave her a headache.
